Scaling gives C_LSI(π_τ)=(1+τ)C_LSI(π), yet the initial derivative of KL to π is -3/2 for the annealed diffusion and only -1 for ordinary Langevin. The paper establishes a bound allowing this increase, not the asserted conditioning improvement.
